java:S3252.name: Static member accessed via subclass
java:S3252.reason: MapStruct and annotation processors often require static constants to be referenced through the target concrete class rather than a base interface.

java:S119.name: Type parameter name convention
java:S119.reason: Generic architectural type parameters (e.g. <T extends AbstractEntity<T>>, <ID, E>) are intentional API contracts.

java:S1135.name: TODO tag tracking
java:S1135.reason: TODO comments must be resolved by genuine implementation, never deleted merely to satisfy SonarQube.

xml:S1135.name: XML TODO tag tracking
xml:S1135.reason: TODO comments in XML must be addressed by implementation, never deleted.

java:S1874.name: Deprecated code usage
java:S1874.reason: @Deprecated methods and classes are intentionally maintained for backward compatibility until major release milestones.

java:S1123.name: Deprecated tag without javadoc
java:S1123.reason: Deprecation tags are maintained intentionally for API contract tracking.

java:S1602.name: Lambda expression block braces
java:S1602.reason: In multi-overloaded functional interfaces, explicit braces `{ return ...; }` disambiguate overloaded functional signatures.

java:S2160.name: Subclass equals override
java:S2160.reason: Subclasses extending a base model that handles reflection or identity equality should not add redundant boilerplate overrides.

java:S6548.name: Singleton pattern
java:S6548.reason: Immutable constants, mappers, and fallback singleton instances use this pattern intentionally.

java:S3011.name: Reflection accessibility bypass
java:S3011.condition: Preserve only in test fixtures or dedicated reflection/serialization utilities; treat as a security/encapsulation issue in Spring Boot production services.

java:S106.name: Standard output usage
java:S106.condition: Preserve only in CLI entrypoints, standalone tools, or migration runners; replace with a logger (SLF4J) in Spring Boot production services.

java:S1172.name: Unused method parameter
java:S1172.condition: Preserve only when required by a polymorphic interface, framework interceptor, or controller signature; otherwise remove the unused parameter.

actionable_rules.java:S1128: Unused import - remove redundant import statement.
